description.en: An oval fossil endocarp has reticulate ridges and a small subapical horn on each face.
description.zh: 卵形化石内果皮具网状脊，每面近顶端各有一小角。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Iodes brownii, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Iodes brownii 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Two opposed face-horns and a reticulate shell differ from Trapa's four long marginal arms.
distinctness.zh: 两面相对角及网脊壳区别于菱属四条长边缘角。

modeling_brief.en: Use a flattened ovoid core with two clear horns and a coarse ridge network; omit microscopic papillae.
modeling_brief.zh: 使用扁卵形核心、两个清晰角和粗网脊，省略显微乳突。

uncertainty: Biceratocarpum brownii is the earlier combination; no duplicate entry under that name.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Revision of Icacinaceae from the Early Eocene London Clay flora based on X-ray micro-CT
sources.supports: Iodes brownii new combination, previously Biceratocarpum brownii; two-horned endocarps.

sources.title: Icacinaceae from the Eocene of western North America
sources.supports: Two subapical horns and reticulate ridges of the Iodes brownii endocarp.
